entities.name: ProSeP
entities.description: Procedure for ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE interaction between upper layers and 5GSM entities.

entities.name: Upper layers
entities.description: Upper layers in the UE that can request 5GSM entity actions for PDU session management.

entities.name: 5GSM entity
entities.description: 5GSM entity in the UE acting as a 5G ProSe layer-3 UE-to-network relay UE.

entities.name: PDU session establishment
entities.description: Procedure to establish a PDU session with specified attributes.

entities.name: PDU session release
entities.description: Procedure to release an existing PDU session.

entities.name: PDU session attributes
entities.description: Attributes of a PDU session including PDU session identity, SSC mode, S-NSSAI, DNN, PDU session type, access type, and PDU address.

relations.description: ProSeP requires interaction between upper layers and 5GSM entities.
ProSeP requires interaction between upper layers and 5GSM entities.
Upper layers may request 5GSM entity to establish a PDU session.
Upper layers may request 5GSM entity to release an existing PDU session.
5GSM entity indicates attributes of newly established PDU session to upper layers.
5GSM entity informs PDU session identity of released PDU session to upper layers.
PDU session establishment indicates one or more PDU session attributes.
